alt: Table declaring the BRFSS 2024 release: coverage without Tennessee, the weighting chain, 2,393 strata with every respondent its own PSU, the need for a lonely-PSU rule, pooling, series breaks, and known traps.
note: Provenance: design.json = machine-readable manifest field; design.json notes = the manifest's free text; producer = documentation read 2026-09-10; computed = counted from the store by build.py; book guidance = editorial, not a producer rule.

rows.value: BRFSS 2024 combined landline and cell-phone file (LLCP2024), released August 2025; store: BRFSS_2026 cleaned parquet (iyear = 2024)

rows.source: producer: CDC 2024 overview; computed from data
rows.value: Noninstitutionalized adults 18 and older in 49 states, DC, Guam, Puerto Rico, and the US Virgin Islands. Tennessee could not collect enough data for the 2024 public file: the target is adults in participating jurisdictions, not US adults

rows.source: producer: CDC complex sampling weights; CDC 2024 weighting description
rows.value: _LCPWTV1, _LCPWTV2, _LCPWTV3 for module questions asked on questionnaire versions 1–3 (files LLCP24V1–LLCP24V3); _CLLCPWT for child interviews

Design weight = _STRWT × (1/NUMPHON4) × NUMADULT (both factors 1 for cell respondents); dual-frame compositing for dual phone users; truncation within region at the mean ± 1.96 SD (_LLCPWT2); raking to 8 state margins plus up to 8 regional and county margins, age by sex last
Only the final xllcpwt; _STRWT, _WT2RAKE, _LLCPWT2, NUMADULT, and NUMPHON4 were dropped by the harmonized build
Taylor linearization with _STSTR (strata) and _PSU (store: xststr, xpsu)
2,393 strata and 457,670 PSUs: every respondent is its own PSU (43,913 distinct PSU codes, reused across strata)

rows.source: computed from data; producer: CDC complex sampling weights
rows.value: Required even for national estimates: 110 strata hold a single respondent in the full 2024 file. CDC's R example sets survey.lonely.psu = "adjust"; the book uses "adjust" in R and "center" in svy
Not covered by the 2024 documents consulted. When pooling years, keep each year's strata distinct and divide weights by the number of years before estimating totals

rows.source: producer: CDC; BRFSS_2026 CHANGELOG; v4 plan
rows.value: Raking and cell phones from 2011 (CDC: begin new trend lines in 2011); coverage changes by year (2021 omits Florida; 2023 omits Kentucky and Pennsylvania; 2024 omits Tennessee); 2020 collection disrupted by COVID; the 2023 file was re-released in February 2025 without sexual orientation and gender identity items, which the 2024 file also omits
Built for state estimates: each state's sample is weighted to its own adult population
Every measure is self-reported by telephone; weighting repairs representation, not measurement
CDC 2024 overview, weighting description, and complex-sampling-weights document read 2026-09-10
